items.t: Florida man receives life sentence for using AI to create child pornography of neighborhood children
items.x: A Martin County judge has ordered a sentence equal to life in prison for a man who used artificial intelligence to create child pornography, a case the Martin County Sheriff's Office said it had never seen at that time.

items.x: The federal government has appealed a court decision allowing California to count ballots allegedly sent to noncitizen voters.

items.x: They said they “seek to protect other American families from becoming casualties in another AR-15 killing spree.”

items.t: Florida mom fights wrongful death law after daughter dies hours after leaving hospital
items.x: Two years after her only daughter died just hours after leaving a Florida hospital, Beth Miller says she is still searching for answers. She also wants to make sure another family does not face the same barriers she has encountered.

items.t: 'Heightened threat environment': Air defense systems deployed at Mar-a-Lago and airport
items.x: Surface-to-air missile systems have been deployed at Mar-a-Lago and Donald J. Trump International Airport at the request of the U.S. Secret Service. A spokesperson said the agency is operating in a heightened threat environment.

items.t: Palm Beach residents raise concerns over planned seawall replacement project
items.x: A major seawall replacement project is expected to begin early next year in the town of Palm Beach, but some residents are raising concerns about the construction timeline and its impact on beach access and traffic.

items.t: 'Don't feel fear': Palm Beach County breast cancer survivor urges women to get screenings
items.x: As Breast Cancer Awareness Month comes to a close, we are hearing from a local survivor about her battle to become cancer-free.

items.t: Judge blocks Trump administration's Medicaid rule forcing sick recipients to prove frailty
items.x: A judge ruled that chronically ill people on Medicaid won't be bound by new work requirement rules that the latest Trump administration guidance requires in order to qualify for "medically frail" exemptions.
